properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated July 24, [1947] on stationery from the Imperial Hotel in Tokyo; includes description of lunch with General Douglas A. and Jean MacArthur and the effect of the visit on dealmaking for Pan American Airways; mentions J.T.T. [Juan Trippe].
